home.title: Meki Batu Union | Ethiopian Fruit & Vegetable Cooperative
home.description: Ethiopia's leading agricultural cooperative — GlobalG.A.P certified red onions, tomatoes, green beans, and seeds from 8,089 Rift Valley farmers. Export inquiries welcome.

about.title: Cooperative Heritage & Governance | Meki Batu Union
about.description: Established in 2002, Meki Batu Union represents smallholder farmer cooperatives committed to democratic governance, quality certifications, and agricultural leadership in Oromia, Ethiopia.

products.title: Horticultural Produce & Certified Seeds | Meki Batu Union
products.description: Export-grade Ethiopian produce: GlobalG.A.P certified red onions, greenhouse tomatoes, green beans, hot peppers, papaya, and inspected hybrid seeds from the Rift Valley.

farmers.title: Farmer Membership & Services | Meki Batu Union
farmers.description: Join 8,089 member farmers in Oromia. Access tractor mechanization, subsidized seeds, agronomy training, and guaranteed fair pricing through cooperative membership.

buyers.title: Export Produce Sourcing & Logistics | Meki Batu Union
buyers.description: Import GlobalG.A.P certified Ethiopian vegetables: red onions, tomatoes, and green beans. Reliable cold-chain export with batch traceability for EU and global buyers.

retailOutlets.title: Fresh Produce Shops in Addis Ababa | Meki Batu Union
retailOutlets.description: Visit 5 official Meki Batu Union retail shops across Addis Ababa. Farm-direct fresh vegetables and fruits delivered daily from the Ethiopian Rift Valley.

news.title: News & Updates | Meki Batu Union
news.description: Latest harvest reports, trade agreements, certification updates, and cooperative assembly news from Meki Batu Union in Ethiopia's Rift Valley.

impact.title: Social Impact & Sustainability | Meki Batu Union
impact.description: Discover how our programs advance women farmer leadership, sustainable drip irrigation, school construction, and rural prosperity in the Rift Valley of Oromia, Ethiopia.

contact.title: Contact Headquarters & Sales | Meki Batu Union
contact.description: Reach our central office in Meki Town or distribution representatives in Addis Ababa for trade inquiries, export orders, membership information, and customer support.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy | Meki Batu Union
privacyPolicy.description: Learn how Meki Batu Union collects, uses, and safeguards personal information submitted through our website and inquiry forms.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service | Meki Batu Union
termsOfService.description: Review the terms and conditions governing the use of the Meki Batu Union website, catalog content, and downloadable resources.
